title.zh: 卷27 志二 天文二 仪象
title.raw: 卷27 志二 天文二 仪象

sentences.zh: 漢創渾天儀，謂即璣衡遺制，唐、宋皆仿為之。

translations.literal: The Han created the armillary sphere, calling it the surviving form of the Armillary and Chronographic device; Tang and Song all copied it.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han the armillary sphere was built, held to be the heir of the ancient armillary chronograph; Tang and Song followed the same design.

sentences.zh: 至元始有簡儀、仰儀、闚幾、景符等器，視古加詳焉。

translations.literal: Only under the Yuan did instruments such as the simplification armillary, the altitude instrument, the sighting tablet, and the shadow marker appear, more detailed than antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan added the simplified armillary, altitude instrument, sighting tablet, and shadow marker—finer in make than older models.

sentences.zh: 明于北京齊化門內倚城築觀象臺，仿元制作渾儀、簡儀、天體三儀，置於臺上。

translations.literal: The Ming, within Beijing's Qihua Gate, built the Observatory Terrace against the city wall, copying Yuan models to make the armillary sphere, simplification armillary, and celestial globe, and set them on the terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In Ming Beijing, beside Qihua Gate, they raised the Observatory Terrace against the wall and placed Yuan-style armillary, simplified armillary, and celestial globe instruments upon it.

sentences.zh: 台下有晷景堂、圭表、壺漏，清初因之。

translations.literal: Below the terrace were the Gnomon Hall, gnomon and table, and clepsydra; the early Qing kept them as they were.
translations.idiomatic: Beneath the terrace stood the Gnomon Hall, a gnomon and table, and clepsydras, retained unchanged at the dynasty's founding.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，聖祖用監臣南懷仁言，改造六儀，曰黃道經緯儀、赤道經緯儀、地平經儀、地平緯儀、紀限儀、天體儀。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi, the Sacred Ancestor, following supervising official Ferdinand Verbiest's counsel, remade six instruments: the ecliptic theodolite, equatorial theodolite, horizontal azimuth instrument, horizontal altitude quadrant, limit-measuring quadrant, and celestial globe.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8 the Kangxi emperor, on Verbiest's advice, commissioned six new instruments: ecliptic theodolite, equatorial theodolite, azimuth theodolite, altitude quadrant, astronomical quadrant, and celestial globe.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，復將地平經、緯合為一儀。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, the horizontal azimuth and altitude instruments were again combined into one instrument.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52 the azimuth and altitude instruments were merged into a single combined instrument.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年，高宗御製璣衡撫辰儀，並安置臺上。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong, the High Ancestor personally made the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and also installed it on the terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 9 the Qianlong emperor built the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and set it on the Observatory Terrace.

sentences.zh: 今考各形制用法，悉著於篇。

translations.literal: Now each instrument's form and use are fully set down in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: What follows records the design and operation of every instrument in full.

sentences.zh: 黃道經緯儀，儀之圈有四，各分四象限，限各九十度。

translations.literal: The ecliptic theodolite has four rings, each divided into four quadrants, each quadrant ninety degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic theodolite comprises four rings, each quartered into ninety-degree quadrants.

sentences.zh: 其外大圈恆定而不移者，名天元子午規，外徑六尺，規面厚一寸三分，側面寬二寸五分，規之下半夾入於雲座。

translations.literal: The outer great ring, fixed and immovable, is called the primary meridian ring; outer diameter six chi, ring face one cun three fen thick, side two cun five fen wide; the ring's lower half is clasped into the cloud pedestal.
translations.idiomatic: Outermost is the fixed primary meridian ring, six chi across, one cun three fen thick on the face and two cun five fen on the edge; its lower half seats in the cloud pedestal.

sentences.zh: 仰載之半圈，前後正直子午，上直天頂，中直地平。

translations.literal: The half ring borne above, front and rear running true north-south, rises straight to the celestial pole and cuts the horizon at center.
translations.idiomatic: The upper semicircle aligns with the meridian, reaches the zenith, and meets the horizon at midpoint.

sentences.zh: 從地平上下按京師南北兩極出入度分，定赤道兩極。

translations.literal: From above and below the horizon, according to the capital's north and south polar entrance and exit in degrees and minutes, the equatorial poles are fixed.
translations.idiomatic: From the horizon upward and downward, using Beijing's polar altitude and depression, the equatorial poles are set.

sentences.zh: 次內為過極至圈，圈周平分處，各以鋼樞貫於赤道二極。

translations.literal: Next inward is the polar-transit circle; at each point where the circumference is equally divided, steel pivots pass through the equatorial poles.
translations.idiomatic: Inside that lies the polar-transit circle, pierced at equal intervals by steel pivots through the equatorial poles.

sentences.zh: 又依黃赤大距度，於過極至圈上定黃道南北極。

translations.literal: Again, by the great distance between ecliptic and equator, the ecliptic's north and south poles are fixed on the polar-transit circle.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic poles are then marked on that circle according to the obliquity of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 距黃極九十度安黃道圈，與過極至圈十字相交，各陷其中以相入，令兩圈為一體，旋轉相從。

translations.literal: Ninety degrees from the ecliptic pole the ecliptic ring is set; it crosses the polar-transit circle at right angles, each notched so they interlock, making the two rings one body that rotate together.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic ring, ninety degrees from the ecliptic pole, intersects the polar-transit circle at right angles in interlocking mortises so both rings move as one.

sentences.zh: 黃道圈之兩側面，一為十二宮，一為二十四節氣。

translations.literal: On the two sides of the ecliptic ring, one bears the twelve mansions, the other the twenty-four solar terms.
translations.idiomatic: One face of the ecliptic ring carries the twelve zodiac mansions; the other carries the twenty-four solar terms.

sentences.zh: 其兩交，一當冬至，一當夏至。

translations.literal: Its two intersections—one at winter solstice, one at summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: The ring's two nodes mark winter solstice and summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 次內為黃道經圈，則以鋼樞貫于黃極焉。

translations.literal: Next inward is the ecliptic meridian circle, which a steel pivot passes through at the ecliptic pole.
translations.idiomatic: Within sits the ecliptic meridian circle, pivoted on steel at the ecliptic pole.

sentences.zh: 圈之徑為圓軸，圍三寸。

translations.literal: The circle's diameter forms a round axle, circumference three cun.
translations.idiomatic: Its diameter is a cylindrical axle three cun around.

sentences.zh: 軸之中心立圓柱為緯表，與經圈側面成直角，而黃道圈經圈上各設遊表，儀頂更設銅絲為垂線。

translations.literal: At the axle's center stands a round column as the latitude index, at right angles to the meridian circle's side; on the ecliptic ring and meridian circle each a sliding sight is set, and atop the instrument a copper wire serves as plumb line.
translations.idiomatic: A latitude pillar rises from the axle center perpendicular to the meridian ring; sliding sights mount on ecliptic and meridian rings, with a copper plumb line at the summit.

sentences.zh: 全儀以雙龍擎之，復為交梁以立龍足。

translations.literal: The whole instrument is borne by twin dragons; a crossed beam again stands the dragons' feet.
translations.idiomatic: Twin dragons support the whole; a cross-beam bears their feet.

sentences.zh: 梁之四端，各承以獅，仍置螺柱以取平。

translations.literal: At the beam's four ends lions bear it up, and screw pillars are still set to level it.
translations.idiomatic: Lions support each end of the beam, with leveling screws beneath.

sentences.zh: 垂線有偏側，則轉螺柱，垂線正，則儀正矣。

translations.literal: If the plumb line leans aside, turn the screw pillars; when the plumb line is true, the instrument is true.
translations.idiomatic: Any tilt of the plumb line is corrected by the screws until the line hangs true and the instrument is aligned.

sentences.zh: 用法，欲求某星黃道經緯度，須一人于黃道圈上查先所得某星之經緯度分，其上加遊表，而過南北軸中柱，表對星定儀；

translations.literal: In use, to seek a star's ecliptic longitude and latitude, one person on the ecliptic ring looks up a star's previously obtained longitude and latitude in degrees and minutes, sets a sliding sight thereon, and through the north-south axle's central pillar aligns sight to star to fix the instrument;
translations.idiomatic: To measure a star's ecliptic coordinates, one operator sets a sight on the ecliptic ring to the star's catalogued longitude and latitude, sights through the central pillar along the polar axis, and fixes the instrument on the star;

sentences.zh: 又一人用游表於經圈上過柱，表對所測之星，遊移取置，則經圈上游表之指線定某星緯度。

translations.literal: another person uses a sliding sight on the meridian circle over the pillar, sighting the star under measurement, sliding and setting it in place; then the sliding sight's indicator line on the meridian circle fixes the star's latitude.
translations.idiomatic: a second slides a sight along the meridian ring over the pillar until it lines on the target; the meridian sight then reads the star's latitude.

sentences.zh: 又定儀查黃道圈兩表相距之度分，即某星之經度差。

translations.literal: With the instrument fixed, read on the ecliptic ring the degrees and minutes between the two sights—that is the star's longitude difference.
translations.idiomatic: Once fixed, the arc between the two ecliptic sights gives the star's longitudinal separation.

sentences.zh: 或測日月，以距星為比，亦如之。

translations.literal: Or when measuring sun or moon, using a reference star for comparison, it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon may be measured the same way against a reference star.

sentences.zh: 赤道經緯儀，儀有三圈，外大圈者，天元子午規也。

translations.literal: The equatorial theodolite has three rings; the outer great ring is the primary meridian ring.
translations.idiomatic: The equatorial theodolite has three rings; the outermost is again the primary meridian ring.

sentences.zh: 以一龍南向而負之。

translations.literal: A single dragon facing south bears it.
translations.idiomatic: One dragon, facing south, supports it.

sentences.zh: 規之分度定極，皆與黃道儀同。

translations.literal: The ring's graduations and pole settings are all the same as on the ecliptic instrument.
translations.idiomatic: Its graduations and polar settings match the ecliptic theodolite.

sentences.zh: 去極九十度安赤道圈，與子午規十字相交，恆定不動。

translations.literal: Ninety degrees from the pole the equatorial ring is set; it crosses the meridian ring at right angles and remains fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The equatorial ring, ninety degrees from the pole, crosses the meridian ring at right angles and does not move.

sentences.zh: 圈內規面及上側面皆鋟二十四時，時各四刻。

translations.literal: On the inner ring face and upper side face are engraved the twenty-four hours, each hour in four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The inner face and upper edge bear twenty-four hours, each divided into four quarters.

sentences.zh: 外規面分三百六十度，內安赤道經圈。

translations.literal: The outer ring face is divided into three hundred sixty degrees; within, the equatorial meridian circle is set.
translations.idiomatic: The outer face carries three hundred sixty degrees; inside sits the equatorial meridian circle.

sentences.zh: 以南北極為樞，而可東西遊轉，與赤道圈內規面相切。

translations.literal: With north and south poles as pivots it can rotate east and west, tangent to the equatorial ring's inner face.
translations.idiomatic: Pivoted at the poles, it swings east and west against the equatorial ring's inner surface.

sentences.zh: 經圈徑為圓軸，軸中心立圓柱，以及遊表、垂線、交梁、螺柱等法，皆同黃道儀。

translations.literal: The meridian circle's diameter is a round axle; a round column stands at the axle center, and sliding sights, plumb line, crossed beam, screw pillars, and the rest follow the ecliptic instrument's method.
translations.idiomatic: Its meridian ring forms a cylindrical axle with a central pillar; sliding sights, plumb line, cross-beam, and leveling screws follow the ecliptic instrument.

sentences.zh: 用法，若測日時刻，則赤道圈上用時刻遊表，即通光耳，對於南北軸表，視赤道圈內遊表所指，即時刻分秒。

translations.literal: In use, to measure the sun's hour, use the hour sliding sight on the equatorial ring—that is the light aperture—opposite the north-south axle sight; what the inner sliding sight on the equatorial ring points to is the hour, minute, and second.
translations.idiomatic: To tell time by the sun, align the hour sight—a light aperture—on the equatorial ring with the polar sight; the inner sight's reading gives hour, minute, and second.

sentences.zh: 若諸曜經度，用兩通光耳，即兩徑表，在赤道圈上一定一遊。

translations.literal: For the longitude of the luminaries, use two light apertures—that is, two diameter sights—on the equatorial ring, one fixed and one movable.
translations.idiomatic: For planetary or stellar longitude, two light apertures (diameter sights) are used on the equatorial ring, one fixed and one sliding.

sentences.zh: 一人從定耳窺南北軸表，與先得星相參測之；

translations.literal: One person peers through the fixed aperture at the north-south axle sight and cross-measures against a star already obtained;
translations.idiomatic: One observer sights through the fixed aperture along the polar axis against a reference star;

sentences.zh: 一人以遊耳轉移遷就，而窺本軸表與所測參相直，視兩耳間應赤道圈上之度分，即兩經度之差也。

translations.literal: another slides the movable aperture into alignment, peering at this axle sight and the object measured in one line; the degrees and minutes on the equatorial ring between the two apertures are the difference of the two longitudes.
translations.idiomatic: the other shifts the sliding aperture until polar sight and target align; the equatorial arc between the two apertures is the longitudinal difference.

sentences.zh: 緯度亦以通光耳於經圈上轉移而遷就焉。

translations.literal: Latitude likewise is obtained by shifting the light aperture on the meridian circle into place.
translations.idiomatic: Latitude is read by sliding the light aperture along the meridian ring into alignment.

sentences.zh: 務欲令目與表與所測相參直，視本耳下經圈在赤道或南或北之度分，即所測距赤道南北之度分也。

translations.literal: One must make eye, sight, and object measured lie in one line; the degrees and minutes on the meridian circle beneath this aperture, south or north of the equator, are the degrees and minutes of distance north or south of the equator for what is measured.
translations.idiomatic: Eye, sight, and body observed must share one line; the meridian reading below the aperture, north or south of the equator, gives the object's declination.

sentences.zh: 地平經儀，儀只一地平圈，全徑六尺，其平面寬二寸五分，厚一寸二分。

translations.literal: The horizontal azimuth instrument has only one horizon ring, full diameter six chi; its plane two cun five fen wide, one cun two fen thick.
translations.idiomatic: The azimuth theodolite consists of a single horizon ring six chi in diameter, two cun five fen wide and one cun two fen thick.

sentences.zh: 分四象限，各九十度。

translations.literal: It is divided into four quadrants, each ninety degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The ring is quartered, ninety degrees per quadrant.

sentences.zh: 以四龍立于交梁以承之。

translations.literal: Four dragons stand on the crossed beam to bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Four dragons on a cross-beam support it.

sentences.zh: 梁之四端，各施取平之螺柱。

translations.literal: At the beam's four ends leveling screw pillars are applied.
translations.idiomatic: Leveling screws sit at each end of the beam.

sentences.zh: 梁之交處安立柱，高與地平圈等，適當地平圈之中心。

translations.literal: At the beam's crossing a pillar is set, as high as the horizon ring, exactly at the horizon ring's center.
translations.idiomatic: Where the beams cross, a pillar rises to the ring's height at its center.

sentences.zh: 又于地平圈上東西各立一軸，約高四尺，柱各一龍，盤旋而上，從柱端各伸一爪，互捧圓珠。

translations.literal: Again on the horizon ring east and west a pillar is set on each side, about four chi high; each pillar has a dragon coiling upward; from each pillar top a claw extends, together holding a round pearl.
translations.idiomatic: East and west on the ring stand pillars about four chi tall, each with a coiling dragon whose claws meet to clasp a pearl.

sentences.zh: 下有立軸，其形扁方，空其中如窗櫺，以安直線。

translations.literal: Below is a standing axle, flat and square in form, hollow within like window lattices, to hold a straight line.
translations.idiomatic: A vertical axle, square and hollow like a window frame, holds the sighting wire.

sentences.zh: 軸之上端入於珠，下端入立柱中心，令可旋轉。

translations.literal: The axle's upper end enters the pearl, the lower enters the pillar's center, so it can rotate.
translations.idiomatic: Its top fits the pearl, its foot the pillar center, allowing rotation.

sentences.zh: 而軸中之線，恆為天頂之垂線焉。

translations.literal: The line within the axle is always the plumb line to the celestial pole.
translations.idiomatic: The wire within remains the zenith plumb line.

sentences.zh: 又為長方橫表，長如地平圈，全徑厚一寸，寬一寸五分，中心開方孔管於立軸下端，使隨立軸旋轉。

translations.literal: Again a long rectangular cross-arm is made, as long as the horizon ring's full diameter, one cun thick, one cun five fen wide; at center a square hole sleeves the standing axle's lower end so it rotates with the standing axle.
translations.idiomatic: A rectangular cross-arm as long as the ring's diameter, one cun thick and one cun five fen wide, sleeves the pillar axle at center and turns with it.

sentences.zh: 復剡其兩端令銳，以指地平圈之度分。

translations.literal: Its two ends are sharpened to point to the horizon ring's degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Both ends are tapered to indicate degrees on the horizon ring.

sentences.zh: 又自兩端各出一線，而上會於立軸中直線之頂，成兩三角形。

translations.literal: From each end again a line runs up to meet the top of the straight line in the standing axle, forming two triangles.
translations.idiomatic: Lines from each end meet the summit of the central wire, forming two triangles.

sentences.zh: 凡有所測，則旋轉遊表，使三線與所測參相直，乃視表端所指，即所測之地平經度也。

translations.literal: For whatever is measured, rotate the sliding sight so the three lines and the object measured lie in mutual alignment; then what the arm's end points to is the object's horizontal azimuth.
translations.idiomatic: For any observation the sliding sight is turned until three lines align on the target; the cross-arm's reading is the azimuth.

sentences.zh: 地平緯儀，即象限儀，蓋取全圓四分之一以測高度者也。

translations.literal: The horizontal altitude instrument is the quadrant instrument—it takes one quarter of the full circle to measure height.
translations.idiomatic: The altitude quadrant is literally a quarter-circle used to measure elevation.

sentences.zh: 其弧九十度，其兩邊皆圓半徑，長六尺。

translations.literal: Its arc is ninety degrees; its two sides are each a semicircle radius, six chi long.
translations.idiomatic: The arc spans ninety degrees; each radial side is six chi, half the full radius.

sentences.zh: 兩半徑交處為儀心。

translations.literal: Where the two radii meet is the instrument's center.
translations.idiomatic: Their intersection is the instrument center.

sentences.zh: 儀架東西立柱，各以二龍拱之。

translations.literal: The instrument frame has east and west pillars; each is arched by two dragons.
translations.idiomatic: East and west pillars frame it, each pair of dragons forming an arch.

sentences.zh: 上架橫樑，又立中柱上管於橫樑，令可轉動儀心，上指儀之兩邊，一與中柱平行，一與橫樑平行。

translations.literal: Above, a crossbeam; again a central pillar is tubed on the crossbeam so the instrument center can turn—the center pointing to the instrument's two sides, one parallel to the central pillar, one parallel to the crossbeam.
translations.idiomatic: A crossbeam above carries a central pillar socketed so the center pivots, one radius parallel to the pillar, one to the beam.

sentences.zh: 又於儀心立短圓柱以為表，又加窺衡，長與半徑等，上端安於儀心，剡其下端，以指弧面度分，更安表耳。

translations.literal: Again at the instrument center a short round column serves as index; a sighting arm is added, as long as the radius; its upper end is set at the instrument center, its lower end sharpened to point to degrees on the arc face, and a sight ear is further set.
translations.idiomatic: At the center a short pillar forms the index; a sighting arm equal to the radius pivots there, its tip reading the arc, with a sighting slit.

sentences.zh: 有所測，乃以窺衡上下遊移，從表耳縫中窺圓柱，令與所測相參直。

translations.literal: For whatever is measured, slide the sighting arm up and down, peering through the sight ear's slit at the round column, making it align with what is measured.
translations.idiomatic: To observe, the arm is slid until the slit sights the pillar in line with the object.

sentences.zh: 其衡端所指度分，即所測之地平緯度也。

translations.literal: The degrees and minutes the arm's end points to are the object's horizontal latitude.
translations.idiomatic: The arc at the arm's tip gives the altitude.

sentences.zh: 紀限儀，弧面為全圓六分之一，分六十度。

translations.literal: The limit-measuring quadrant: the arc face is one sixth of the full circle, divided into sixty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The astronomical quadrant's arc is one sixth of a circle, graduated to sixty degrees.

sentences.zh: 一弧一幹，幹長六尺，即全圓之半徑。

translations.literal: One arc, one radius; the radius six chi long—that is the full circle's radius.
translations.idiomatic: One arc and one radius—the radius six chi, the full circle's radius.

sentences.zh: 弧之寬二寸五分，幹之左右，細雲糾縵纏連，所以固之。

translations.literal: The arc is two cun five fen wide; left and right of the radius fine cloud patterns twine and link to secure it.
translations.idiomatic: The arc is two cun five fen wide; cloud-scroll filigree flanks the radius to stiffen the frame.

sentences.zh: 幹之上端有小衡，與幹成十字。

translations.literal: At the radius's upper end is a small cross-arm, at right angles to the radius.
translations.idiomatic: A short transom crosses the radius at its head.

sentences.zh: 儀心與衡兩端皆立圓柱為表，弧面設遊表。

translations.literal: At the instrument center and both ends of the cross-arm round columns serve as indices; a sliding sight is set on the arc face.
translations.idiomatic: Round index pillars stand at center and transom ends; a sliding sight rides the arc.

sentences.zh: 承儀之台，約高四尺，中植立柱，以系儀之重心，則左右旋轉，高低斜側，無所不可，故又名百遊儀焉。

translations.literal: The platform bearing the instrument is about four chi high; a pillar is planted at center to tie the instrument's center of gravity, so it can rotate left and right, high or low, slanting or sidelong—nothing is impossible—hence it is also called the Hundred-Motion Instrument.
translations.idiomatic: A stand about four chi tall centers a pillar at the instrument's balance point so it may swing in every attitude—hence its alias, the Hundred-Motion Instrument.

sentences.zh: 用法，測兩曜，不論黃赤經緯，而求大圈相距之度，一人從衡端耳表窺中心柱表，對定此曜；

translations.literal: In use, measuring two luminaries, regardless of ecliptic or equatorial longitude and latitude, to seek the degrees of great-circle separation, one person peers from the cross-arm end's ear index at the center pillar index, fixing this luminary;
translations.idiomatic: To measure angular distance between two bodies regardless of coordinate system, one sights from the transom slit through the center index onto the first body;

sentences.zh: 又一人從游耳表向中心柱表窺彼曜相參直，視衡端至遊耳表下度分，即兩曜相距度分也。

translations.literal: another peers from the sliding ear index toward the center pillar index at that luminary in mutual alignment; the degrees and minutes from the cross-arm end to beneath the sliding ear index are the two luminaries' separating degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: the second sights from the sliding slit through the center index onto the second; the arc from transom to sliding sight is their separation.

sentences.zh: 天體儀，儀為圓球，徑六尺，宛然穹象，故以天體名之。

translations.literal: The celestial globe: the instrument is a round sphere, diameter six chi, vividly a vaulted image—hence the name celestial body.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial globe is a sphere six chi across, shaped like the dome of heaven.

sentences.zh: 中貫鋼軸，露其兩端，以屬於子午規之南北極，令可轉運。

translations.literal: A steel axle passes through its center, both ends exposed, attached to the meridian ring's north and south poles, so it can be turned.
translations.idiomatic: A steel polar axis pierces it and joins the meridian ring's poles so the sphere may revolve.

sentences.zh: 座高四尺七寸。

translations.literal: The pedestal is four chi seven cun high.
translations.idiomatic: The stand rises four chi seven cun.

sentences.zh: 座上為地平圈，寬八寸。

translations.literal: Above the pedestal is a horizon ring, eight cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: On the stand sits a horizon ring eight cun wide.

sentences.zh: 當子午處各為闕，以入子午規。

translations.literal: At the meridian positions on each side are gaps for the meridian ring to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Notches at north and south admit the meridian ring.

sentences.zh: 闕之度與子午規之寬厚等，則兩圈十字相交，內規面恰平，而左右上下環抱乎儀。

translations.literal: The gap's measure equals the meridian ring's width and thickness; then the two rings cross at right angles, the inner ring face exactly level, and left, right, above, and below embrace the instrument.
translations.idiomatic: The notches match the meridian ring's section so the rings cross squarely, the inner face flush, cradling the globe on all sides.

sentences.zh: 周圍皆空五分，以便高弧遊表進退。

translations.literal: All around is left a clearance of five fen so the high-arc sliding sight can advance and retreat.
translations.idiomatic: A five-fen gap all around lets the altitude sight travel freely.

sentences.zh: 又安時盤於子午規外，徑二尺，分二十四時。

translations.literal: Again a hour dial is set outside the meridian ring, diameter two chi, divided into twenty-four hours.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the meridian ring a two-chi hour dial shows twenty-four hours.

sentences.zh: 以北極為心，其指時刻之表，亦定於北極，令能隨天體轉移，又能自轉焉。

translations.literal: With the north pole as center, the hand indicating the hour is also fixed at the north pole, able to shift with the celestial globe and also rotate on its own.
translations.idiomatic: An hour pointer pivoted at the north pole moves with the globe and may also spin independently.

sentences.zh: 座下復設機輪，運轉子午規，使北極隨各方出地升降，各方天象隱見之限，皆可究觀矣。

translations.literal: Below the pedestal gearing is again set to turn the meridian ring, making the north pole rise and set with each region's emergence from earth; the limits of each region's celestial phenomena hidden and visible can all be studied.
translations.idiomatic: Gears beneath drive the meridian ring so the pole lifts and sinks for any latitude, revealing what stars each region may see.

sentences.zh: 地平經緯合儀，經儀中心立柱安緯儀。

translations.literal: The combined horizontal azimuth-altitude instrument: at the azimuth instrument's center pillar the altitude instrument is set.
translations.idiomatic: The combined instrument mounts the altitude quadrant on the azimuth instrument's central pillar.

sentences.zh: 用法，旋轉緯儀，對定所測游表，於緯儀上得緯度；

translations.literal: In use, rotate the altitude instrument, align the sliding sight on what is measured, and obtain latitude on the altitude instrument;
translations.idiomatic: In use one swings the altitude quadrant, sights the target, and reads latitude from it;

sentences.zh: 視緯儀邊切經儀之處，即得經度：一測而兩得焉。

translations.literal: view where the altitude instrument's edge cuts the azimuth instrument—that gives longitude: one measurement yields both.
translations.idiomatic: where its edge meets the azimuth ring gives longitude—both coordinates in one observation.

sentences.zh: 璣衡撫辰儀，儀制三重，其在外者，即古六合儀，而不用地平圈，其正立雙環為子午圈。

translations.literal: The Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument: the instrument has three tiers; the outermost is the ancient six-combination armillary, but without the horizon ring; upright twin rings form the meridian circle.
translations.idiomatic: The Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument has three nested frames; the outer recreates the ancient six-ring armillary without a horizon ring, its upright double ring serving as meridian.

sentences.zh: 兩面皆刻周天三百六十度，自南北極起，初度至中要九十度，是為天經。

translations.literal: Both faces are engraved with the circuit of heaven's three hundred sixty degrees; from north and south poles, first degree to midpoint ninety degrees—that is celestial longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Both faces bear three hundred sixty degrees of celestial longitude, ninety degrees from each pole to the equator crossing.

sentences.zh: 斜倚單環為天常赤道圈，兩面皆刻周日十二時，以子正午正當子午雙環中空之半，而結於其中要，是為天緯。

translations.literal: A single ring leans obliquely as the fixed ecliptic equator circle; both faces are engraved with the circuit of the sun's twelve hours; zi and wu noon rightly occupy the meridian double ring's hollow half, knotting at its midpoint—that is celestial latitude.
translations.idiomatic: An oblique single ring is the fixed equator, engraved with twelve double-hours; noon and midnight sit in the meridian gap at its center—that is celestial latitude.

sentences.zh: 其南北二極皆設圓軸，軸本實於子午雙環中空之間，而軸內向，以貫內二重之環。

translations.literal: At both north and south poles round axles are set; the axle roots are solid within the meridian double ring's hollow, while inward the axle pierces the inner two tiers' rings.
translations.idiomatic: Polar axles seat in the meridian ring and turn inward to carry the inner rings.

sentences.zh: 其下承以雲座，仰面正中開雙槽以受雙環，東面正中開雲窩以受垂線。

translations.literal: Below it is borne on a cloud pedestal; the upturned face's center has twin grooves to receive the double ring; the east face's center has a cloud recess to receive the plumb line.
translations.idiomatic: A cloud pedestal supports it with twin slots for the meridian ring and an eastern cloud niche for the plumb line.

sentences.zh: 下面置十字架，施螺旋以取平。

translations.literal: Below, a cross of four legs is set, with screws to level.
translations.idiomatic: A four-footed cross below carries leveling screws.

sentences.zh: 架之東西兩端各植龍柱，龍口銜珠，開孔以承天常赤道卯酉之兩軸，依觀象臺測定南北正線，將座架安定，則平面之四方正。

translations.literal: At the frame's east and west ends dragon pillars are planted; dragon mouths hold pearls, holes opened to bear the fixed equator's mao-you east-west axles; according to the Observatory Terrace's fixed north-south true line the frame is secured—then the plane's four directions are true.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon pillars east and west grip pearls pierced to hold the equator's east-west axis; aligned to the terrace's meridian, the base squares to the four directions.

sentences.zh: 又依京師北極出地度分，上數至成一象限，即天頂。

translations.literal: Again according to the capital's north polar altitude in degrees and minutes, count upward to complete one quadrant—that is the celestial pole.
translations.idiomatic: Counting up from Beijing's polar altitude through one quadrant marks the zenith.

sentences.zh: 依南極入地度分，下數成一象限，即地心。

translations.literal: According to the south pole's depression in degrees and minutes, count downward to complete one quadrant—that is the earth's center.
translations.idiomatic: Counting down from the south polar depression through one quadrant marks the nadir.

sentences.zh: 于天頂施小釘懸垂線，而垂適當地心，又適切於雙環之面。

translations.literal: At the celestial pole set a small nail to suspend the plumb line; the plumb rightly reaches the earth's center and also rightly cuts the double ring's face.
translations.idiomatic: A nail at the zenith suspends the plumb line to the nadir, grazing the meridian ring's plane.

sentences.zh: 線末垂球，又適當云窩，不即不離，則上下正立面之四方亦正，而地平已在其中。

translations.literal: At the line's end hangs a ball, again rightly fitting the cloud recess, neither touching nor leaving—then above and below are true, the plane's four directions also true, and the horizon is already within it.
translations.idiomatic: A sphere at the line's foot nests in the cloud niche without binding; then vertical, horizontal, and horizon are all true.

sentences.zh: 次其內即古三辰儀，而不用黃道圈。

translations.literal: Next within is the ancient three-luminaries armillary, but without the ecliptic ring.
translations.idiomatic: Inside that lies the ancient three-luminaries armillary, omitting the ecliptic ring.

sentences.zh: 其貫於二極之雙環，為赤極經圈。

translations.literal: The double ring piercing the two poles is the equatorial-pole meridian circle.
translations.idiomatic: The polar double ring is the equatorial meridian circle.

sentences.zh: 兩極各設軸孔，以受天經之軸，兩面皆刻周天三百六十度。

translations.literal: At both poles axle holes are set to receive the celestial-longitude axle; both faces are engraved with the circuit of heaven's three hundred sixty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Polar sockets take the longitude axle; both faces repeat the three hundred sixty-degree circuit.

sentences.zh: 結於赤極圈之中要，與天常赤道平運者，為遊旋赤道圈，兩面皆刻周天三百六十度，與宗動天赤道旋轉相應。

translations.literal: Knotting at the equatorial-pole circle's midpoint, parallel with the fixed equator and moving with it, is the revolving equator circle; both faces are engraved with the circuit of heaven's three hundred sixty degrees, turning in accord with the primum mobile's equator.
translations.idiomatic: At its center a revolving equator, parallel to the fixed ring and engraved with three hundred sixty degrees, tracks the primum mobile's equator.

sentences.zh: 自經圈之南極，作兩象限弧以承之，使不傾墊。

translations.literal: From the meridian circle's south pole, two quadrant arcs are made to bear it so it does not tilt or list.
translations.idiomatic: Quadrant arcs from the southern meridian support it against tilt.

sentences.zh: 次最內即古四遊儀，貫於二極之雙環，為四遊圈，兩面皆刻三百六十度。

translations.literal: Next innermost is the ancient four-motion armillary; the double ring piercing the two poles is the four-motion circle, both faces engraved with three hundred sixty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Innermost is the four-motion armillary: a polar double ring, the four-motion circle, engraved with three hundred sixty degrees on both faces.

sentences.zh: 定于遊圈之兩極者為直距，綰於直距之中心者為窺衡。

translations.literal: What is fixed at the two poles of the motion ring is the straight pivot; what is lashed at the center of the straight pivot is the sight-tube.
translations.idiomatic: The straight pivot is fixed at both poles of the motion ring; the sight-tube is lashed to its center.

sentences.zh: 遊圈中要設直表，以指經度及時，窺衡右旁設直表，以指緯度。

translations.literal: Within the motion ring one must set a straight sight to indicate right ascension and time; to the right of the sight-tube one sets a straight sight to indicate latitude.
translations.idiomatic: A straight sight inside the ring marks right ascension and time; another beside the sight-tube marks latitude.

sentences.zh: 別設借弧指時度表、立表、平行立表、平行借弧表，以濟所測之窮。

translations.literal: Separately are set a borrowed-arc time-degree indicator, upright sights, parallel upright sights, and parallel borrowed-arc sights, to remedy limits of what can be measured.
translations.idiomatic: Auxiliary borrowed-arc, upright, parallel upright, and parallel borrowed-arc sights cover cases the main setup cannot reach.

sentences.zh: 又設綰經度表、綰時度表、平行線測經度表，以期兩測之合。

translations.literal: Also are set a pin right-ascension gauge, a pin time gauge, and a parallel-line right-ascension gauge, so that two measurements may agree.
translations.idiomatic: Pin gauges for right ascension and time plus a parallel-line right-ascension gauge align paired readings.

sentences.zh: 其數，子午圈外徑六尺三寸，內徑五尺六寸六分，環面闊三寸二分，厚九分，中空一寸。

translations.literal: The dimensions: meridian circle outer diameter six feet three inches, inner diameter five feet six inches six fen, ring face width three inches two fen, thickness nine fen, hollow center one inch.
translations.idiomatic: The meridian circle measures 6 ft 3 in outer, 5 ft 6.6 in inner, 3.2 in face width, 0.9 in thick, with a 1 in hollow center.

sentences.zh: 天常赤道外徑六尺一寸二分，內徑五尺六寸四分，環面闊二寸四分，厚一寸四分。

translations.literal: Constant celestial equator outer diameter six feet one inch two fen, inner diameter five feet six inches four fen, ring face width two inches four fen, thickness one inch four fen.
translations.idiomatic: The constant celestial equator ring is 6 ft 1.2 in outer, 5 ft 6.4 in inner, 2.4 in face width, and 1.4 in thick.

sentences.zh: 赤極經圈外徑五尺五寸六分，內徑五尺一寸二分，環面闊二寸八分，厚八分，中空一寸二分。

translations.literal: Celestial-pole meridian circle outer diameter five feet five inches six fen, inner diameter five feet one inch two fen, ring face width two inches eight fen, thickness eight fen, hollow center one inch two fen.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial-pole meridian circle is 5 ft 5.6 in outer, 5 ft 1.2 in inner, 2.8 in face width, 0.8 in thick, with a 1.2 in hollow center.

sentences.zh: 遊旋赤道外徑五尺五寸六分，內徑五尺一寸二分，環面闊二寸二分，厚一寸二分。

translations.literal: Revolving equator outer diameter five feet five inches six fen, inner diameter five feet one inch two fen, ring face width two inches two fen, thickness one inch two fen.
translations.idiomatic: The revolving equator ring is 5 ft 5.6 in outer, 5 ft 1.2 in inner, 2.2 in face width, and 1.2 in thick.

sentences.zh: 四遊圈外徑五尺，內徑四尺六寸八分，環面闊一寸六分，厚七分，中空一寸四分。

translations.literal: Four-motion ring outer diameter five feet, inner diameter four feet six inches eight fen, ring face width one inch six fen, thickness seven fen, hollow center one inch four fen.
translations.idiomatic: The four-motion ring is 5 ft outer, 4 ft 6.8 in inner, 1.6 in face width, 0.7 in thick, with a 1.4 in hollow center.

sentences.zh: 直距長如圓之通徑，闊一寸六分，厚七分，中空一寸四分。

translations.literal: Straight pivot length equals the circle's full diameter, width one inch six fen, thickness seven fen, hollow center one inch four fen.
translations.idiomatic: The straight pivot spans the ring's full diameter, 1.6 in wide, 0.7 in thick, with a 1.4 in hollow center.

sentences.zh: 窺衡長四尺七寸二分，方一寸二分，中空一寸。

translations.literal: Sight-tube length four feet seven inches two fen, square one inch two fen, hollow center one inch.
translations.idiomatic: The sight-tube is 4 ft 7.2 in long, 1.2 in square, with a 1 in hollow bore.

sentences.zh: 上下兩端施方銅蓋，厚五分，內三分，方一寸，入于管中，外二分，方一寸二分，齊于管面，中心開圓孔。

translations.literal: At both upper and lower ends square copper caps are fitted, thickness five fen, inner three fen, square one inch, entering the tube; outer two fen, square one inch two fen, flush with the tube face; a round hole is opened at the center.
translations.idiomatic: Square copper caps cap both ends: 0.5 in thick, 1 in square inside the tube, 1.2 in square flush outside, with a central round hole.

sentences.zh: 指時度表，通長七寸三分，本長一寸六分，形如方筒，入于四遊雙環中空之間，闊一寸四分，橫帶長三寸二分，闊五分，兩端各鉤回二分，扣於環面之外。

translations.literal: Time-degree indicator, overall length seven inches three fen, body length one inch six fen, shaped like a square tube, entering the hollow between the four-motion double rings, width one inch four fen; cross-strap length three inches two fen, width five fen; both ends each hook back two fen and clasp outside the ring face.
translations.idiomatic: The time-degree indicator is 7.3 in overall, 1.6 in body, a square tube in the four-motion ring hollow, 1.4 in wide, with a 3.2 by 0.5 in cross-strap hooked 0.2 in at each end over the ring face.

sentences.zh: 表長五寸二分，闊一寸。

translations.literal: Indicator length five inches two fen, width one inch.
translations.idiomatic: The indicator plate is 5.2 in long and 1 in wide.

sentences.zh: 其指時度之邊線，對方筒之正中，下端二寸四分，厚三分，切于遊旋赤道之面，以指度分。

translations.literal: Its time-degree edge line faces the square tube's center; lower end two inches four fen, thickness three fen, tangent to the revolving equator face, to indicate degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: The time-degree edge aligns with the tube center; the lower 2.4 in, 0.3 in thick, lies tangent to the revolving equator to mark degrees.

sentences.zh: 上端二寸八分，厚二分，切于天常赤道之面，以指時刻。

translations.literal: Upper end two inches eight fen, thickness two fen, tangent to the constant celestial equator face, to indicate the hour.
translations.idiomatic: The upper 2.8 in, 0.2 in thick, lies tangent to the constant celestial equator to mark the hour.

sentences.zh: 指緯度表，其形兩曲，安於窺衡之右面。

translations.literal: Latitude indicator, its form doubly curved, mounted on the right face of the sight-tube.
translations.idiomatic: The latitude indicator is doubly curved and mounted on the sight-tube's right face.

sentences.zh: 底長三寸，闊九分，曲橫七分，與四遊環之厚等。

translations.literal: Base length three inches, width nine fen, curve span seven fen, equal to the four-motion ring's thickness.
translations.idiomatic: Its base is 3 in long, 0.9 in wide; the curve spans 0.7 in, matching the four-motion ring's thickness.

sentences.zh: 又曲長一寸七分，切于四遊環之外面，從中線減闊之半，所以指緯度也。

translations.literal: Again the curve length one inch seven fen, tangent to the four-motion ring's outer face; from the center line half the width is cut away — thus it indicates latitude.
translations.idiomatic: A further 1.7 in curve lies tangent to the ring's outer face; half the width is trimmed from the center line to mark latitude.

sentences.zh: 借弧指時度表，其本方筒及橫帶長闊並與前指時度表同。

translations.literal: Borrowed-arc time-degree indicator: its square tube and cross-strap length and width are all the same as the foregoing time-degree indicator.
translations.idiomatic: The borrowed-arc time-degree indicator matches the main indicator's square tube and cross-strap dimensions.

sentences.zh: 橫帶之下，自左向右，立安弧背一道，長九寸三分，闊一寸二分，厚一分六釐。

translations.literal: Below the cross-strap, from left to right, an arc back is set upright, length nine inches three fen, width one inch two fen, thickness one fen six li.
translations.idiomatic: Below the cross-strap a curved back is set left to right: 9.3 in long, 1.2 in wide, 0.16 in thick.

sentences.zh: 弧背之末，平安指時度表，除弧背之厚，長五寸二分，闊一寸。

translations.literal: At the arc back's end a level time-degree indicator is set; deducting the arc back's thickness, length five inches two fen, width one inch.
translations.idiomatic: At the arc's end sits a level time-degree indicator, 5.2 by 1 in apart from the arc's thickness.

sentences.zh: 計自表本方筒之中線至指時度表之內邊，長六寸七分，當遊旋赤道之十五度，當天常赤道之一小時。

translations.literal: From the indicator's square-tube center line to the time-degree indicator's inner edge, length six inches seven fen, equivalent to fifteen degrees on the revolving equator and one hour on the constant celestial equator.
translations.idiomatic: From the square-tube center to the indicator's inner edge is 6.7 in — fifteen degrees on the revolving equator, one hour on the constant celestial equator.

sentences.zh: 立表二座，形直底平，表高底長各三寸二分，闊九分，厚一分。

translations.literal: Two upright sights, form straight with flat base; sight height and base length each three inches two fen, width nine fen, thickness one fen.
translations.idiomatic: Two upright sights, straight with flat bases, each 3.2 in high and long, 0.9 in wide, 0.1 in thick.

sentences.zh: 一表向上開長方孔，長一寸，中留直線，又上五分開圓孔，徑四分，中留十字線，安於窺衡之上端。

translations.literal: One sight opens upward with a long rectangular aperture one inch long, a straight line left in the middle; again five fen above opens a round hole, diameter four fen, a cross line left in the middle; mounted on the sight-tube's upper end.
translations.idiomatic: One sight has a 1 in rectangular slot with a center line, then a 0.4 in round hole 0.5 in above with crosshairs, on the sight-tube's upper end.

sentences.zh: 一表依前度下開直縫，上開小圓孔，安於窺衡下端，各對衡面中線，以螺旋結之。

translations.literal: One sight by the foregoing measure opens a straight slit below and a small round hole above, mounted on the sight-tube's lower end; each faces the tube face center line, fastened with screws.
translations.idiomatic: The other has a lower slit and upper pinhole on the lower end, each aligned to the tube center line and screwed fast.

sentences.zh: 平行立表二座，形曲底平，底盤長四寸，闊一寸二分，厚一分，中空三寸二分，闊九分。

translations.literal: Two parallel upright sights, form curved with flat base; base plate length four inches, width one inch two fen, thickness one fen, hollow center three inches two fen, width nine fen.
translations.idiomatic: Two parallel upright sights curve from flat bases: base plate 4 by 1.2 in, 0.1 in thick, with a 3.2 by 0.9 in hollow center.

sentences.zh: 表曲如勾股。

translations.literal: The sight curves like a right triangle.
translations.idiomatic: Each sight forms a right triangle.

sentences.zh: 股直如立表，高三寸二分，闊九分。

translations.literal: The vertical leg straight like an upright sight, height three inches two fen, width nine fen.
translations.idiomatic: The vertical leg stands like an upright sight, 3.2 in high and 0.9 in wide.

sentences.zh: 勾橫連於股末，長五寸，闊九分，橫植於底盤之末。

translations.literal: The horizontal leg joins the leg's end, length five inches, width nine fen, set crosswise at the base plate's end.
translations.idiomatic: The horizontal leg joins the foot, 5 by 0.9 in, cross-mounted at the base plate's end.

sentences.zh: 底盤中空，冒於立表底盤之外，以掐表固之。

translations.literal: The base plate is hollow and sleeves over the upright sight's base plate outside, pinching the sight to fix it.
translations.idiomatic: The hollow base plate sleeves over the upright sight's base and clamps it fast.

sentences.zh: 平行借弧表，制如平行立表，而倒正異。

translations.literal: Parallel borrowed-arc sight, made like the parallel upright sight, but inverted in orientation.
translations.idiomatic: The parallel borrowed-arc sight matches the parallel upright sight but reversed in orientation.

sentences.zh: 一表上植於衡面，高四寸一分零八毫，一表自衡面下垂，長六寸二分零八毫。

translations.literal: One sight is planted upward on the tube face, height four inches one fen zero eight li; one sight hangs down from the tube face, length six inches two fen zero eight li.
translations.idiomatic: One sight rises 4.108 in from the tube face; the other hangs 6.208 in below it.

sentences.zh: 距表端下六分開圓孔，又下五分開長方孔，皆與立表制同。

translations.literal: Six fen below the sight end a round hole is opened; again five fen below opens a long rectangular hole — all like the upright sight's make.
translations.idiomatic: Each has a round hole 0.6 in from the end and a rectangular slot 0.5 in lower, as on the upright sights.

sentences.zh: 綰經度表，通長四寸，闊一寸四分。

translations.literal: Pin right-ascension gauge, overall length four inches, width one inch four fen.
translations.idiomatic: The pin right-ascension gauge is 4 in long and 1.4 in wide overall.

sentences.zh: 其本方筒長一寸六分，高一寸八分，入于四遊雙環之間，以左右螺旋固之。

translations.literal: Its square tube body length one inch six fen, height one inch eight fen, entering between the four-motion double rings, fixed left and right with screws.
translations.idiomatic: Its 1.6 by 1.8 in square tube sits between the four-motion double rings and is screwed fast on both sides.

sentences.zh: 其末上下二面，以夾遊旋赤道，上面闊七分，減本之半，與窺衡中線相直，下面以螺旋固之。

translations.literal: Its end's upper and lower two faces clamp the revolving equator; the upper face width seven fen, half the body cut away, aligns straight with the sight-tube center line; the lower face is fixed with a screw.
translations.idiomatic: The end's upper and lower jaws clamp the revolving equator; the upper jaw, 0.7 in wide and half the body trimmed, aligns with the sight-tube center line; the lower is screwed fast.

sentences.zh: 綰時度表，內外二截，內截上下內三面，綰于遊旋赤道之內規。

translations.literal: Pin time gauge, inner and outer two sections; the inner section's upper, lower, and inner three faces are lashed to the revolving equator's inner rim.
translations.idiomatic: The pin time gauge has inner and outer sections; the inner section's three inner faces lash to the revolving equator's inner rim.

sentences.zh: 上面之末，承於外截之下，開二方孔，以受外截之方足，下面以螺旋固之。

translations.literal: The upper face's end rests under the outer section, two square holes opened to receive the outer section's square feet; the lower face is fixed with a screw.
translations.idiomatic: The inner upper end supports the outer section below, with square holes for the outer feet; the lower face is screwed fast.

sentences.zh: 外截上下外三面，綰于天常赤道之外規。

translations.literal: The outer section's upper, lower, and outer three faces are lashed to the constant celestial equator's outer rim.
translations.idiomatic: The outer section's three outer faces lash to the constant celestial equator's outer rim.

sentences.zh: 上面之末，覆於內截之上，下面以螺旋固之。

translations.literal: The upper face's end covers above the inner section; the lower face is fixed with a screw.
translations.idiomatic: The outer upper end caps the inner section; the lower face is screwed fast.

sentences.zh: 平行線測經度表，于直距南北極之兩端，各安銅版，如工字形，正方二寸八分，與直距二面之分等。

translations.literal: Parallel-line right-ascension gauge: at both ends of the straight pivot's south and north poles, copper plates are each set, like the character gong, square two inches eight fen, equal to the straight pivot's two faces' divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the straight pivot's north and south ends sit gong-shaped copper plates, 2.8 in square, matching the pivot's face divisions.

sentences.zh: 兩要各缺一長方，長一寸六分，闊七分，扣於直距中空之間。

translations.literal: Both arms each lack one long rectangle, length one inch six fen, width seven fen, clasping the straight pivot's hollow center.
translations.idiomatic: Each arm has a 1.6 by 0.7 in rectangular notch clasping the pivot's hollow center.

sentences.zh: 中心開圓孔，貫於天經之軸。

translations.literal: At the center a round hole is opened, pierced by the celestial-axis shaft.
translations.idiomatic: A central round hole receives the celestial-axis shaft.

sentences.zh: 四隅距中心一寸九分，各安立柱，圓頂開孔，以穿直線，與直距中徑平行。

translations.literal: At the four corners, one inch nine fen from the center, upright posts are each set; round tops open holes to thread a straight line, parallel to the straight pivot's center diameter.
translations.idiomatic: At each corner 1.9 in from center stands a post with a holed round cap for a line parallel to the pivot's bore axis.

sentences.zh: 下安小環，以為結赤經平行線之用。

translations.literal: Below a small ring is set, for tying the right-ascension parallel line.
translations.idiomatic: A small ring below serves to tie the right-ascension parallel line.

sentences.zh: 又按距星宮度，于游旋赤道安赤經平行線表，其制上畫半圓，內容半方，自對角斜線起，初度至橫徑為四十五度，其中直徑與指度表之邊線相參直。

translations.literal: Again by the reference star's mansion and degree, on the revolving equator a right-ascension parallel-line gauge is set; its make draws a semicircle above containing a half square; from the diagonal slant line, initial degree to the cross diameter is forty-five degrees; its vertical diameter aligns straight with the degree indicator's edge line.
translations.idiomatic: By the reference star's mansion and degree a right-ascension parallel-line gauge on the revolving equator bears a semicircle over a half square; from the diagonal, initial degree to cross diameter is forty-five degrees, its vertical diameter aligned with the degree indicator's edge.

sentences.zh: 半圓中心安二遊表，各長二寸，距中心一寸九分。

translations.literal: At the semicircle's center two traveling indicators are set, each length two inches, one inch nine fen from the center.
translations.idiomatic: Two traveling indicators, each 2 in long, sit 1.9 in from the semicircle's center.

sentences.zh: 邊留小臍，中開小圓孔，以線穿之。

translations.literal: At the edge a small navel is left; a small round hole is opened in the middle, for threading a line.
translations.idiomatic: Each edge has a small navel with a central hole for a line.

sentences.zh: 上端系於北極銅版對角之兩環，下端貫於南極銅版對角之兩環，各以垂球墜之。

translations.literal: The upper end is tied to the two rings at the north-pole copper plate's diagonal; the lower end passes through the two rings at the south-pole copper plate's diagonal; each is weighted with a plummet.
translations.idiomatic: The upper end ties to the north plate's diagonal rings; the lower passes the south plate's diagonal rings, each weighted with a plummet.

sentences.zh: 用法，測日時刻，以四遊圈東西推轉，窺衡南北低昂，令日光透孔圓正，視四遊圈下指時度表臨天常赤道某時刻，即得。

translations.literal: Method of use: to measure the sun's hour, push the four-motion ring east and west, raise and lower the sight-tube north and south, until sunlight through the hole is round and true; then view under the four-motion ring the time-degree indicator against the constant celestial equator's given hour — that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To read solar time, turn the four-motion ring east-west and tilt the sight-tube north-south until sunlight through the aperture is round and true; the time-degree indicator under the ring against the constant celestial equator gives the hour.

sentences.zh: 若日景為赤道所礙，則用窺衡上立表測之，令表兩孔正透，仍于指時度表視時刻。

translations.literal: If the sun's shadow is blocked by the equator, then use the upright sight on the sight-tube to measure, making both sights' holes align true; still read the hour on the time-degree indicator.
translations.idiomatic: If the equator blocks the sun's ray, use the sight-tube's upper upright sight with both holes aligned and still read the time-degree indicator.

sentences.zh: 或為龍柱所礙，則用平行立表測之，亦于指時度視時刻。

translations.literal: Or if blocked by the dragon pillars, then use the parallel upright sight to measure; again read the hour on the time-degree indicator.
translations.idiomatic: If dragon pillars block the view, use the parallel upright sight and read the time-degree indicator.

sentences.zh: 若指時度表為子午圈所礙，則易用借弧指時度表，次用平行立表。

translations.literal: If the time-degree indicator is blocked by the meridian circle, then change to the borrowed-arc time-degree indicator, next the parallel upright sight.
translations.idiomatic: If the meridian circle blocks the time-degree indicator, switch to the borrowed-arc indicator, then the parallel upright sight.

sentences.zh: 測定日景，視借弧指時度表所指時刻，加一小時，即得。

translations.literal: Measuring the sun's shadow, view the hour the borrowed-arc time-degree indicator indicates and add one hour — that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: For a shadow reading, take the borrowed-arc indicator's hour and add one hour.

sentences.zh: 測經度，取所知正午前後一恆星，以其赤道經度之對沖，用綰經度表于遊旋赤道綰定四遊圈。

translations.literal: Measuring right ascension: take a known fixed star before or after noon, use its equatorial right ascension's opposition, and with the pin right-ascension gauge lash the four-motion ring to the revolving equator.
translations.idiomatic: To measure right ascension, take a known star near noon, set the pin right-ascension gauge at the opposition of its equatorial right ascension, and lash the four-motion ring to the revolving equator.

sentences.zh: 又任設一時，用綰時度表，于其時之對沖，綰天常赤道。

translations.literal: Again set any chosen hour; with the pin time gauge at that hour's opposition, lash the constant celestial equator.
translations.idiomatic: Choose an hour and lash the constant celestial equator with the pin time gauge at its opposition.

sentences.zh: 乃將四遊圈帶定遊旋赤道，用窺衡測准距星，隨之左旋。

translations.literal: Then bring the four-motion ring with the revolving equator fixed, use the sight-tube to sight the reference star true, and rotate left with it.
translations.idiomatic: Lock the four-motion ring to the revolving equator, sight the reference star through the sight-tube, and rotate west with it.

sentences.zh: 候至所設時刻，視綰時度表對遊旋赤道某宮度分，即日赤道經度。

translations.literal: Wait until the set hour; view the pin time gauge against the revolving equator's mansion and degree — that is the day's equatorial right ascension.
translations.idiomatic: At the set hour read the pin time gauge against the revolving equator's mansion and degree for the sun's equatorial right ascension.

sentences.zh: 或以本時太陽赤道經度，用綰時度表于遊旋赤道綰定，又以所設時刻之對沖，于天常赤道綰定。

translations.literal: Or take the present sun's equatorial right ascension, lash with the pin time gauge on the revolving equator, and again lash the constant celestial equator at the opposition of the set hour.
translations.idiomatic: Alternatively lash the revolving equator with the sun's current equatorial right ascension and the constant celestial equator at the set hour's opposition.

sentences.zh: 候至所設時刻，用四遊窺測月星，乃視指時度表所指游旋赤道宮度，加半周，即得所測月星赤道經度。

translations.literal: Wait until the set hour, use the four-motion sight to observe moon or star; then view the time-degree indicator's indicated mansion on the revolving equator, add half a circuit — that is the measured moon or star's equatorial right ascension.
translations.idiomatic: At the set hour sight moon or star through the four-motion tube; the time-degree indicator's mansion on the revolving equator plus half a circuit gives its equatorial right ascension.

sentences.zh: 測兩曜相距經度，用平行線測經度表于游旋赤道初宮初度安定，令一人用此平行線表、左兩線、右兩線，並窺定距西之曜，隨之左旋；

translations.literal: Measuring the longitudinal separation of two luminaries: set the parallel-line right-ascension gauge on the revolving equator at the first mansion, first degree, and fix it; let one person use this parallel-line gauge, left two lines and right two lines together, to sight and fix the western luminary, rotating left with it;
translations.idiomatic: To measure separation between two bodies, fix the parallel-line right-ascension gauge at the revolving equator's first mansion, first degree; one observer sights the western body with left and right line pairs and rotates west with it;

sentences.zh: 一人用四遊窺衡測距東之曜，視指時度表所指遊旋赤道之度分，即所測兩曜相距赤道經度也。

translations.literal: one person uses the four-motion sight-tube to measure the eastern luminary; view the time-degree indicator's indicated degrees and minutes on the revolving equator — that is the measured two luminaries' equatorial longitudinal separation.
translations.idiomatic: another sights the eastern body through the four-motion sight-tube; the time-degree indicator's degrees on the revolving equator give their equatorial longitudinal separation.

sentences.zh: 測緯度，凡得經度時，隨察指緯度表所指四遊圈之度分，即得所測赤道緯度。

translations.literal: Measuring latitude: whenever right ascension is obtained, at once inspect the latitude indicator's indicated degrees and minutes on the four-motion ring — that is the measured equatorial latitude.
translations.idiomatic: For latitude, whenever right ascension is found, read the latitude indicator's degrees on the four-motion ring for equatorial latitude.

sentences.zh: 其有所礙，皆如測時刻法易之。

translations.literal: Where there is obstruction, all are changed as in the method for measuring the hour.
translations.idiomatic: Any obstruction is handled by the same substitutions used for hour measurement.

sentences.zh: 其近北極之星，則以平行借弧表測之。

translations.literal: For stars near the north pole, then use the parallel borrowed-arc sight to measure them.
translations.idiomatic: Stars near the north pole are measured with the parallel borrowed-arc sight.
